(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (split-blank-cols grid)
      (let loop ([c 0] [panels (list)])
        (cond [(>= c (cols grid)) (reverse panels)]
              [(all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 0)) (range 0 (rows grid)))
               (loop (+ c 1) panels)]
              [else
               (let scan ([stop c])
                 (if (or (>= stop (cols grid))
                         (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r stop) 0)) (range 0 (rows grid))))
                     (loop (+ stop 1)
                           (cons (subgrid grid 0 c (- (rows grid) 1) (- stop 1)) panels))
                     (scan (+ stop 1))))])))
    (define (binary grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid)
        (lambda (r c) (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 1))))
    (define (row-lex< a b)
      (cond [(empty? a) (not (empty? b))]
            [(empty? b) #f]
            [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
            [else (row-lex< (rest a) (rest b))]))
    (define (grid-lex< a b)
      (cond [(empty? a) (not (empty? b))]
            [(empty? b) #f]
            [(not (equal? (first a) (first b))) (row-lex< (first a) (first b))]
            [else (grid-lex< (rest a) (rest b))]))
    (define (canonical grid)
      (let* ((shape (binary grid))
             (variants (list shape
                             (rotate-cw shape)
                             (rotate-180 shape)
                             (transpose shape)
                             (flip-lr shape)
                             (flip-ud shape)
                             (rotate-cw (flip-lr shape))
                             (rotate-ccw shape))))
        (first (sort (map crop-to-content variants) grid-lex<))))
    (let* ((panels (map crop-to-content (split-blank-cols g)))
           (canons (map canonical panels))
           (n (length canons)))
      (grid-from-fn n n
        (lambda (r c)
          (cond [(= r c) 5]
                [(equal? (nth canons r) (nth canons c)) 2]
                [else 0]))))))
